question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

Marie was stunned by this horrible misfortune and endured heartbreaking anguesh.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"anguesh"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is** "anguish"**. (पीड़ा)

 
 
• **Example: **She was in deep** anguish** after hearing the tragic news.
 
 
 
• **"Anguish"** refers to severe mental or physical pain or suffering. (कष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **His face was contorted with **anguish** as he recounted the accident.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Endured** (सहना): To suffer something painful or difficult patiently.

 
 
• **Example:** They endured many hardships during their journey.
 
 
 
• **Misfortune** (दुर्भाग्य): Bad luck; an unfortunate condition or event.
 
 
• **Example: **He had the misfortune of losing his job just before the holidays.
 
 
 
• **Stunned** (स्तब्ध): To be shocked or astonished.
 
 
• **Example:** She was stunned by the unexpected news.
